description: Example scenarios for the application flow; these records are documentation and are not loaded as live applications.

scenarios.name: Load internships
scenarios.expectedResult: JSON object with items array and total count.

scenarios.name: Reject malformed application
scenarios.expectedResult: Per-field validation messages; no application stored.

scenarios.expectedResult: Confirmation with generated application ID and received status.

scenarios.name: Rate limiting
scenarios.expectedResult: Retry-After header and friendly JSON error after request limit.
